# Source Register

Reusable source list for German fictional dentist-demo legal pages. Use it to understand what each source contributes before editing a sample Impressum, sample Datenschutz, accessibility note, demo disclosure, or safe fictional data. This is not legal advice and does not replace client counsel.

## Source hierarchy

Do not treat one source as the whole legal checklist. For a dentist Impressum, work in layers:

1. **Federal baseline** — §5 DDG defines the general provider-information fields for business digital services in Germany.
2. **Profession/state layer** — dentist chambers and state-specific guidance explain which authority, chamber, professional title, professional rules, and access links fit the Bundesland/Kammerbezirk.
3. **Practice layer** — practice form, register entries, VAT/economic ID, KZV relevance, liquidation status, and editorial content determine which conditional fields are needed.
4. **Real operator layer** — public demos still need real operator legal pages; fictional sample pages do not replace them.

Berlin and Schleswig-Holstein are examples of this layering: both start from §5 DDG, but the responsible authority, chamber, KZV relevance, professional-rule access, and exact wording differ by state/chamber guidance.

## Core sources

| Source | Provides | Use for |
|---|---|---|
| [DDG full official law text](https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/ddg/BJNR0950B0024.html) | Full Digitale-Dienste-Gesetz context. | Use for orientation when a question goes beyond §5 provider information. For sample Impressum fields, use §5 directly. |
| [§5 DDG official law text](https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/ddg/__5.html) | General provider-information duties for business digital services. | Impressum field checklist, reachability requirement, conditional fields for legal entities, registers, VAT/economic ID, liquidation, and audiovisual media services. |
| [Zahnärztekammer Berlin Pflichtangaben DDG PDF](https://www.zaek-berlin.de/dateien/Content/Dokumente/Zahn%C3%A4rzte/Zahn%C3%A4rzte_Download/Berufsrecht_Gesetze_und_Rechtliches/Pflichtangaben_nach_dem_Digitale-Dienste-Gesetz.pdf) | Berlin dentist-specific orientation for §5 DDG: LAGeSo, chamber address, professional title, professional rules, and DDG §33 risk note. | Berlin-based fictional dentist samples and internal audit notes for dentist Impressum coverage. |
| [Zahnärztekammer Berlin Berufsrecht](https://www.zaek-berlin.de/zahnaerzte/berufsrecht.html) | Access point for Berlin dental professional rules and chamber legal material. | Professional-rule links in Berlin dentist samples. |
| [ZHG official law text](https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/zhg/) | Official federal law text for the Gesetz über die Ausübung der Zahnheilkunde. | Direct professional-rule link in the sample Impressum. The slug is `/zhg/`, not `/z_hg/`. |
| [GOZ official law text](https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/goz_1987/) | Official federal law text for the Gebührenordnung für Zahnärzte. | Direct professional-rule link in the sample Impressum. |
| [Berufsordnung der Zahnärztekammer Berlin PDF](https://www.zaek-berlin.de/dateien/Content/Dokumente/Zahn%C3%A4rzte/Zahn%C3%A4rzte_Download/Berufsrecht_Gesetze_und_Rechtliches/Berufsordnung_der_Z%C3%84K_Berlin.pdf) | Berlin chamber professional code PDF. | Direct professional-rule link in the sample Impressum when Berlin is the fictional practice location. |
| [BlnHKG Berlin law database](https://gesetze.berlin.de/bsbe/document/jlr-HeilBKGBErahmen) | Berlin Heilberufekammergesetz in the Berlin law database. | Direct professional-rule link in the sample Impressum when Berlin is the fictional practice location. |
| [KZV Berlin Anfahrt](https://www.kzv-berlin.de/anfahrt) | KZV Berlin contact/address details. | KZV Berlin sample data when the fictional Berlin practice is shown as a contract dental practice. Keep KZV separate from the professional chamber. |
| [SIHK Hagen Impressum guidance](https://www.ihk.de/hagen/recht/rechtsthemen/aktuelles/merkblatt-impressum-4269300) | Practical orientation on Impressum duty, who needs an Impressum, phone plus e-mail, authority/register postal address, two-click reachability, image/license notes, DDG §33 risk, and further information duties. | Footer/header access, persistent real-operator links, richer §5 DDG implementation checks, and wording around "leicht erkennbar, unmittelbar erreichbar, ständig verfügbar". Cross-check any ODR mention against the EU ODR closure source below. |
| [§18 MStV](https://www.gesetze-bayern.de/Content/Document/MStV-18) | Information duties for journalistic-editorial telemedia. | Add a responsible person section when the demo/client site has article, blog, or editorial content where §18 Abs. 2 MStV may apply. |

## State-specific dentist examples

| Source | Provides | Use for |
|---|---|---|
| [Zahnärztekammer Schleswig-Holstein Impressumpflicht](https://www.zahnaerzte-sh.de/website-zahnarztpraxis-impressumpflicht/) | Schleswig-Holstein dentist Impressum orientation: supervisory authority, KZV where contract dental activity applies, chamber, professional title, professional rules access, VAT ID where assigned. | Use when adapting the dentist legal config for Schleswig-Holstein instead of Berlin; it shows why the DDG baseline must be combined with state/chamber guidance. |
| [KZVB Praxis Website](https://www.kzvb.de/digitalisierung-ti/praxis-website) | Bavaria dentist website orientation: Bayerische Landeszahnärztekammer, responsible Bezirksregierung as approbation authority, KZVB where contract dental activity applies, and BFSG note for appointment booking. | Use when adapting the dentist legal config for Bavaria/Munich instead of Berlin. |

## Datenschutz and device storage

| Source | Provides | Use for |
|---|---|---|
| [BfDI information duties](https://www.bfdi.bund.de/DE/Buerger/Inhalte/Allgemein/Datenschutz/Informationspflichten.html) | Art. 13 DSGVO orientation when personal data is collected directly from a person. | Privacy-policy structure, controller/processing/rights/supervisory-authority checks. |
| [§38 BDSG official law text](https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/bdsg_2018/__38.html) | German rules for data-protection officers in non-public bodies. | Avoiding a blanket "Datenschutzbeauftragte:r: TODO" default; use conditional wording instead. |
| [§25 TDDDG official law text](https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/ttdsg/__25.html) | Device storage/access rules, not limited to cookies. | Theme switcher, localStorage, cookies, analytics, embedded services, and consent wording. |

| Source | Provides | Use for |
